title: You May Not Have to Pay Amazon Sales Tax After All
summary: Amazon.com Inc. has received approval for a referendum to let California voters decide on overturning a new state law that mandates online retailers collect sales taxes. This law expands the definition of physical presence for sales tax collection, aiming to generate an additional $200 million annually for California. Amazon needs to gather over 500,000 signatures by late September to bring this measure to a statewide vote in February.

title: Microsoft apologizes for 'crass' Amy Winehouse tweet
summary: Microsoft apologized for a "crass" tweet from its Xbox PR account that encouraged followers to buy Amy Winehouse's album after her death. Other companies like Apple and Amazon also featured Winehouse's music prominently, leading to a significant surge in sales of her album "Back to Black." The incident sparked online criticism regarding companies seemingly capitalizing on the musician's passing.

title: Is Travelzoo Shareholder-Unfriendly?
summary: Travelzoo's founder, Ralph Bartel, holds a controlling interest (over 51%) in the company, raising concerns about shareholder representation despite the board having a majority of independent directors. The article highlights potential self-serving arrangements, such as consulting fees paid to Ralph Bartel's brother, Holger Bartel, who is also the company's chairman. While high insider ownership can be positive, Bartel's control could make it difficult for other shareholders to enact meaningful change.

title: Interview with Sonos founder and CEO John MacFarlane
summary: This article features an interview with Sonos founder and CEO John MacFarlane, discussing the launch of the new Sonos Play:3 and the company's rebranding efforts to make multiroom audio more accessible. MacFarlane emphasizes Sonos's commitment to delivering a high-quality music experience, distinguishing itself from pure tech companies, and explains how their proprietary mesh network simplifies wireless audio for users. He also touches on how Sonos integrates with custom installers and views Apple AirPlay.
